summary: This bill prohibits federal agencies from restricting or impairing individuals' ability to use convertible virtual currency to buy goods or services for their own use or to self-custody digital assets via self-hosted wallets for lawful purposes.

scores.thoughts: The bill prohibits federal agencies from restricting individual use of convertible virtual currency for personal purchases or self-custody. It contains no provisions related to government spending, budgets, appropriations, or fiscal expenditures. No impact on expanding or reducing spending.
The bill addresses restrictions on using virtual currency for purchases but does not mention taxes, tax rates, deductions, or any fiscal policy changes. No relation to higher or lower taxes.
No mention of healthcare, insurance, coverage, or medical services. The bill is solely about virtual currency use.
The bill has no content related to firearms, regulations, rights, or Second Amendment issues.
No provisions on immigration, borders, pathways, or protections.
No reference to abortion, reproductive rights, or related policies.
The bill does not address military, defense spending, or national security expenditures.
No environmental regulations, climate protections, or energy policies mentioned.
No welfare, food stamps, or social programs discussed.
No education funding, schools, or choice provisions.
No drug enforcement, decriminalization, or related measures.
The bill allows transactions for 'lawful purposes' but does not engage with sentencing, policing, or justice reform.
While virtual currency could facilitate purchases, the bill focuses on domestic agency restrictions for personal use, not international trade, tariffs, or protectionism.
No discussion of deficits, debt reduction, or fiscal priorities.
No LGBTQ+ protections or limitations addressed.
No foreign aid provisions.
No voting access, elections, or integrity measures.

The bill directly prohibits federal agencies from restricting self-custody of digital assets via self-hosted wallets and personal use of convertible virtual currency, which are blockchain/crypto technologies. Self-hosted wallets emphasize user control and privacy from centralized oversight. This strongly favors less regulation on tech (crypto) and enhances individual privacy/control over digital assets, aligning with +1 (less regulation on tech and privacy). The entire bill centers on this deregulation.
No labor protections, unions, or employer issues.
No religious exemptions or anti-discrimination priorities.
